title: JarvisAPI
body:
**I'm happy because I've completed my dream project :)**

![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fdec689391bf3e4b9e116d387e0dcfa9abce455e_0.webp)

Talk to your world. Literally.

JarvisAPI is a voice-controlled assistant mod for Minecraft.
Change the time, switch game modes, and execute basic commands instantly—just by speaking.

Powered by offline speech recognition (Vosk), low CPU usage, and Actionbar feedback, Jarvis communicates with you without disrupting gameplay.

**🎙️ Hold the “V” key and speak**

# **🗣️ Available Voice Commands (v1.0.0):**

“Day” → Instantly sets the time to day

“Creative” → Switches your game mode to Creative

“Survival” → Switches your game mode to Survival

“Help” → Displays the command list

**⚠️ This release is in Beta. More commands and improvements are coming soon.**
